results.title: Pipedrive Pricing, Plans & Features (2026) | SalesHive
results.content:
Pipedrive sells four paid plans, priced per seat. Pipedrive's own pages put the range at $14 to $79 per seat per month on annual billing, and you can try it free for 14 days. Monthly billing costs more, because Pipedrive discounts annual plans.

Your real bill is seats × plan price + add-ons + top-ups. Pipedrive's billing guide says you pay for every seat whether or not it is assigned to a user, so remove unused seats before renewal. [...] How much does Pipedrive cost in 2026?

Pipedrive lists four plans priced per seat, from $14 to $79 per seat per month on annual billing (US prices, checked November 3, 2026). Lite is $14, Growth $39 and Ultimate $79. Premium appeared as $59 in the indexed pricing page, so confirm it directly. Monthly billing costs more, and add-ons and top-ups are extra.

Does Pipedrive have a free plan or a free trial? [...] | Plan | Annual billing, per seat | What we could confirm |
 --- 
| Lite | $14/mo ($168/yr) | Core pipeline, contacts and activities. LeadBooster, Projects, Smart Docs, Campaigns and Web Visitors are add-ons. |
| Growth | $39/mo ($468/yr) | Workflow automation and revenue forecast reports. Top-ups for automations, reports, leads and deals and API tokens start here. |

results.title: How much does Pipedrive cost in 2026? — Method
results.content:
Pipedrive’s tiered plans are fairly easy to follow. Each tier adds more tools and flexibility, so you can choose what matches your team’s size and sales process.

Here are Pipedrive’s four main pricing tiers:

|  |  |  |
 --- 
| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing |
| Lite | $14/seat/month | $24/seat/month |
| Growth | $39/seat/month | $49/seat/month |
| Premium | $49/seat/month | $79/seat/month |
| Ultimate | $79/seat/month | $99/seat/month | [...] There’s no exact cost when subscribing to Pipedrive. Its paid plans start at $14 per user/month for Lite (entry-level plan), but the real cost usually goes up once you factor in add-ons, automation, and additional seats.

For example, adding LeadBooster, Campaigns, or Projects can easily double your monthly bill. Your total will depend on team size, required features, and billing frequency (monthly or annually).

## Are the cheaper Pipedrive plans enough for my business? [...] |  |  |  |
 --- 
| Add-on | Monthly rate | What it includes |
| LeadBooster 🚀 | From $32.50/month per company | Chatbot, live chat, web forms, Prospector |
| Web Visitors 👥 | $49/month (up to 200 orgs)  $99/month (201–500 orgs) $299/month (501–2000 orgs) | Identify, count, and track leads from visiting organizations |
| Campaigns 📣 | Starting from $13.33/company | Email marketing, tracking, analytics, filtering, automation on Growth+ plans |

To view and edit your current subscription, open the account menu in the top-right corner and go to Billing.
